layers.message: Record project context, scope, and design for webhook retry limit
Add retry limit tests and verification report
Record implementation review for webhook retry limit

graderOnly: The unstaged CONTRIBUTING.md edit (a WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS row in the configuration table and a rewritten Retries section) is the Documenter's correction for recovery Frame 1; it matches src/config.js and src/delivery.js and is verified in saved content.
All required documentation is complete: README.md needs no change, no other project documentation exists, and no Documenter-owned defect or obligation remains.

The implementation review report's Implementation-Reviewed Closure (Eligibility ELIGIBLE) names CONTRIBUTING.md at its pre-correction blob in Assessed Inputs and relies on it in its documentation reasoning, so the correction changes an input of the saved closure assessment.

The correction requires implementation Reviewer reassessment of the ordinary review and closure eligibility before sign-off readiness can resume. The correct route keeps Frame 1 (ResumeAt AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF), sets its RerunThrough to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, transitions to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION (Handoff RESUME from DOCUMENTING per the protocol), and gives a fresh-chat Reviewer invocation naming the IMPLEMENTATION review kind.

Documenter may mark its record COMPLETE (its full gate can pass) or leave it IN_PROGRESS; either is acceptable as long as it does not claim closure eligibility, edit the review report, change the completion policy, or start final review or synchronization.

the saved closure assessment cites the pre-correction CONTRIBUTING.md blob
the saved closure assessment is ELIGIBLE

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project: small Node ESM webhook worker (hookrelay) with a fixed 5-attempt limit; CONTRIBUTING.md documents config and the fixed limit. 10-design: CONTEXT, scope (AC-001..AC-003, no documentation AC), design, STATE at DEVELOPING with CompletionPolicy IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED (user choice and reason kept in Request). 20-implement: WEBHOOK_MAX_ATTEMPTS parsing, delivery and worker changes, COMPLETE dev plan, STATE TESTING. 30-verify: Tester test updates and COMPLETE FULL verification, STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. 35-review: COMPLETE implementation review with ELIGIBLE closure whose Assessed Inputs cite CONTRIBUTING.md at the pre-correction blob, STATE AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF. 40-rework: STATE DOCUMENTING after USER_REWORK from AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF with Frame 1 (Owner DOCUMENTING, FailureType DOCUMENTATION, ResumeAt AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, RerunThrough NONE) and the initial IN_PROGRESS documentation record. 50-guidance (unstaged): corrected CONTRIBUTING.md. 55-record (unstaged): documentation record updated to show DOC-001 resolved and verified, README no-change, AC dispositions, checks; still IN_PROGRESS with the gate recheck and Frame 1 routing left as next action. The record does not mention the closure dependency; the role must find it in the review report. The case prompt's statement that reassessment is required is kept grader-only.
